Add support for Vi/Vim

I modeled these Vim color scheme files after the ones in the [Vim repo](https://www.github.com/vim/colorschemes). At the same time, I tried to simplify Vim’s list of [highlight](https://vimdoc.sourceforge.net/htmldoc/syntax.html#highlight-groups) groups, focusing on HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and the ones Vim typically uses for web development.

This pull request does not include definitions for every highlight group available in Vim. That seemed outside the scope of an initial pull request. It does, however, account for the bulk of those highlight groups, primarily by [linking](https://vimdoc.sourceforge.net/htmldoc/syntax.html#:highlight-link) to one of Vim’s preferred [group names](https://vimdoc.sourceforge.net/htmldoc/syntax.html#group-name).

Because different editions of Vim support different color sets, I also tried to mimic the CSS definitions in the [a11y `/dist/highlight` directory](https://github.com/ericwbailey/a11y-syntax-highlighting/blob/main/dist/highlight/a11y-dark...
